timing: Independent adjudicator only after both anonymous quality panels seal; before condition reveal.

candidates: every opaque quality candidate, no condition labels

causes.reason: why original source/native/visual evidence establishes this product cause and cross-version matching
evidence: exact original panel and artifact references

candidate-id: unresolved original manifestation/cause; delivery cannot be complete

limits: Independent AI judgment; no human gold; do not infer precision truth from a source declaration.

rules: Every jointly product-attributed raw alarm and agreed source/manual F or extra finding requires explicit disposition/mapping; do not silently export zero defects.
One common cause per platform across states/routes; same conceptual bug in independent iOS/Android code can require separate fixes.
Only independent panel agreement plus original evidence establishes a confirmed product cause. Disagreement remains uncertain.
A strict numeric failed comparison is not by itself a product defect or a false alarm. Preserve raw F/U unchanged.
If initial cause is confirmed but final mapping unknown, do not mark it repaired; rate point estimates become N/A with bounds.
Keep business behavior distinct from accessibility/testability, rendered style, API and source-only declarations.
Zero product-defect/claim/judged-alarm denominators are N/A, never 100% or0% inferred performance.
